ui.tagline: Choose exercises, then send the prescription to your patient.
ui.searchPh: Exercise number or name (e.g. 4, 7 or knee)
ui.searchHelp: Type exercise numbers separated by commas, or part of an exercise name.
ui.regionsSub: Select one or more areas to see suitable home exercises.
ui.protoSub: Ready-made programs with dosage. One tap → ready to send.
ui.sendSub: The WhatsApp message will contain exercise numbers, names and descriptions.
ui.noRegion: No exercises found for the selected body region.
ui.noneSelected: No exercises selected yet. Go back to Exercises and tick what you want the patient to do.

XHCQEtVDjWMl4MRfNXaA.d: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees, squeezing your buttocks. Hold for a few seconds, then lower your hips slowly.

10K9JuHOMsT389tuUaHB.d: Get into a push-up–like position, resting on your forearms and the tips of your toes. Keep your back straight and your whole body in one straight line.

M73X3rzbP6bctEuO4ROx.d: Wrap a resistance band around your knees before you start. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Slowly lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders. As you lift, push your knees slightly outward against the band to work the outer thigh muscles as well as the buttocks, then lower slowly.

BsBeyGvAYUYJEImXZtFP.d: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot on the floor, and keep the other leg straight in the air. Lift your hips using only the leg on the floor, keeping the raised leg straight and your hips level without tilting, then lower slowly.

0QEjlqYYyQrjnYWWCK2o.d: Lie on your back and pull one knee toward your chest with your hands until you feel a gentle stretch in your lower back and buttocks. Hold for 15 to 30 seconds, then return the leg and repeat with the other leg.

nwlcAPPRgFE3lIqGsxMV.d: Lie on your back with your knees bent. Draw your lower belly in, as if bringing your belly button toward your spine, without holding your breath. Hold this for a few seconds while breathing normally, then relax.

kCPyM0q0ZZLA4LQ6cmgP.n: Anterior pelvic tilt (lying on your back)
kCPyM0q0ZZLA4LQ6cmgP.d: Lie on your back with your legs straight or bent, whichever is more comfortable. Gently tilt your pelvis forward so the arch of your lower back lifts slightly off the floor, without lifting your buttocks. Hold for a few seconds, then return to normal. This is a small movement and should not cause any pain.

a4YRVoygjjenEi2ANuOo.d: Lie on your back with your knees bent. Draw your lower belly in so the tightening is only in the deepest layer of your abdominal muscles, without tensing the outer belly muscles or holding your breath. Hold this position while breathing normally.

NV5sJHp8nELPdh8KHLcf.d: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet on the floor. Place your palm on the outside of the opposite knee. Push your hand against the knee while pushing the knee against your hand with equal force, in opposite directions, so that nothing actually moves. Keep this pressure for 5 to 8 seconds, focusing on tightening the muscles on the side of your belly, then release slowly and with control. Repeat the required number of times before switching sides.

sdQUqByH368g9ITIL7nv.d: Lie on your back with your knees bent and place a small ball or pillow between your knees. Squeeze the ball or pillow with your knees to tighten your inner thigh muscles. Hold for a few seconds, then relax.

EKu4x95LHazsUIWhvZAw.d: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot on the floor, and the other leg fully straight. Tighten the muscle at the front of the thigh of the straight leg, then lift it to the height of the bent knee without bending it, and lower it slowly.

HmNssjFRC92f7vFgLL32.d: Lie on your back in a doorway and rest one leg straight up against the wall as far as you can (if the muscle is tight, the leg will be at less than a right angle), while the other leg lies straight on the floor through the doorway. This stretches the back of the thigh and eases lower-back tightness while keeping your spine straight and supported.

Au8w07k3Jj7Q3XUjr0et.d: Lie on your back and place the ankle of the affected leg over the knee of the other leg, making a figure 4. Hold the back of the other thigh and pull it toward your chest until you feel a stretch deep in the buttock on the affected side. Hold for 15 to 30 seconds.

QeLRyqdutnY01Xx7yhAa.d: Lie on your back holding a light weight or a band, with your arm straight up toward the ceiling. At the end of the movement, push your arm a little higher by lifting your shoulder blade slightly off the floor, then lower it slowly.

QrULXDLmbuwTxnc1ANgs.d: Lie down or sit with your leg fully straight. Press the back of your knee down into the floor as if tightening the muscle at the front of your thigh, without moving the leg. Hold for a few seconds, then relax.

MnROkT8dVJXn1RJrBnf9.d: Lie on your stomach with your hands under your shoulders. Push with your hands to lift your upper body while your hips and thighs stay on the floor, then slowly return to the starting position. Stop at the first feeling of pain and do not continue the movement past it.

ZbEOkY1JSlCS1iUV7CYC.d: Lie on your stomach and squeeze both buttocks together for a few seconds without moving your legs or back, then relax.

jo3YQ869KPBPBMJqpaj2.d: Lie on your stomach and squeeze both buttocks together for a few seconds without moving your legs or back, then relax.

qPYDjVpgIXqFTV4NBRO5.d: Lie on your stomach with your arms by your sides. Lift your chest and upper body off the floor using only your lower-back muscles, without pushing with your arms. Hold for a few seconds, then lower slowly.

5HCKnrSfTjFJwZYQm9Vh.d: Lie on your stomach and bring your bent elbows close to your sides so your arms and body form a W. Lift your arms slightly off the floor while squeezing your shoulder blades back and down. Hold for 2 seconds, then lower slowly.

qVph6w1qooW5EdJrc3iQ.d: Lie on your stomach and stretch your arms straight out to the sides at shoulder level to form a T. Lift your arms by squeezing your shoulder blades toward your spine, then lower them with control.

QsE2qCQliDBDYQkFfG6y.d: Lie on your stomach and stretch your arms forward and out at an angle to form a V, thumbs pointing up toward the ceiling. Lift your arms slightly using your upper-back and shoulder-blade muscles, then lower them slowly.

dKjsWHB7NPiSFWiIOmvX.d: Lie on your side with both legs straight. Lift the top leg up, keeping it fully straight and without letting it drift forward or back, then lower it slowly.

H4TLrue7AzUk1qnSShCF.d: Lie on your side with your knees bent to about 45 degrees and your heels together. Open the top knee upward like a clam shell, without moving your pelvis or rolling it back, then lower it slowly.

YGNtoKZUBccUZkDLOhZf.d: Lie on your side with your hips and knees bent to about 90 degrees and your knees together. Keep your lower body still and turn your upper trunk and top arm back toward the floor behind you, following your hand with your eyes, until you feel a gentle stretch in your spine. Return slowly.

28z5UaX1DT7CB1nRiNGr.d: Stand facing the wall and place your forearms vertically on the wall, with a foam roller or resistance band between your hands. Slowly slide your forearms up and down the wall, pressing gently forward and pushing your shoulder blades outward to target the muscle.

ykvaLLUuZmMeu7b5KKCu.d: Lie on your affected side with that shoulder directly under you. Bend the elbow to 90 degrees with the forearm in front of you, then use your other hand to gently push the forearm toward the floor until you feel a stretch at the back of the shoulder.

QmPZGNXThOeG00rTs1zl.d: Stand in front of a stable chair with your feet shoulder-width apart. Slowly lower yourself as if to sit, about halfway down or until you lightly touch the chair, then push back up with your legs. Do not let your knees fall inward.

0ENuVIeLgeLsnIDYLbHK.d: Stand in front of a stable step or platform. Step up fully with the leg you want to strengthen first, then bring up the other leg. Step down in the same order, so the affected leg comes down first.

jX4ehryovn5qyDrV1ciV.d: Stand holding something stable for balance. Rise up onto your toes, hold for 1 second, then lower slowly.

aQdK6B7iGuDjF3QtnQ46.d: Take a step forward into a lunge with your back knee on the floor. Push your hips forward while keeping your body upright until you feel a stretch at the front of the thigh of the back leg. Hold for 15 to 30 seconds.

DscS9tjay4KFZEioHkAp.d: Stand on the edge of a stair on the front of your foot only, with your heel off the step, holding something stable for balance. Lower your heel below the level of the step until you feel a stretch at the back of your lower leg. Hold, then come back up.

TJaf4QcS8JzitMYpie5D.d: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Slowly shift your body weight from one leg to the other, side to side, without lifting your feet. Then repeat shifting forward and back, to improve balance and body control.

nFwUDNioVAW0Wqh5kBYJ.d: Stand holding something stable with your good hand and lean forward slightly, letting the affected arm hang down loosely. Gently swing the arm in small circles or forward and back, letting the movement come from your body rocking, not from using your shoulder muscles.

62r9EeYQHEwLzbJrNUjB.d: Hold a band or a light weight with your elbow fixed at your side. Bend your forearm up toward your shoulder, then lower it slowly.

JVFwUTpOC8jleuHBUliV.d: Stand beside the band's anchor point and bend the elbow farther from it to 90 degrees, keeping it against your side. Hold the band and rotate your forearm up and out, away from your belly, keeping your elbow against your body the whole time. Hold for 1 second at the end, then slowly return.

aKSTOgauCO6oIuAKDKiy.d: Stand beside the band's anchor point and bend the elbow closer to it to 90 degrees, keeping it against your side. Hold the band and rotate your forearm inward toward your belly, keeping your elbow in place. Hold for 1 second at the end, then slowly return outward toward the anchor point.

HKvHtkHZW13jOoLFnpLf.d: Get into a push-up position, on your knees or on your feet, and do a normal push-up. At the top, push a little further so your chest moves farther from the floor and your shoulder blades spread apart from your spine.

UouRbDD58UPnZ221IrlZ.d: Stand on the band and hold both ends. Raise your arm up and out to the side at an angle, in a Y shape, while drawing your shoulder blade down and back.

R5GI3z4sMsA7KWU3LILH.d: Stand with your back against the wall, arms bent and touching the wall in roughly a W shape. Slide your arms up over your head, trying to keep them touching the wall as much as possible, then slowly return to the start.

BAUihH7JwhAt7YDwOauv.d: Stretch your arm out in front of you and tuck your thumb into your palm, closing your other fingers over it. Slowly bend your wrist toward the little finger until you feel a gentle stretch on the thumb side of the wrist. Hold for 15 to 30 seconds.

A3X6j6WpHRsdKO4CBjhL.d: Stretch your arm out in front of you with the palm facing up. With your other hand, pull your fingers down and back until you feel a stretch on the inside of the forearm. Hold for 15 to 30 seconds.

54BIsZIKrOBAJ677ZhDv.d: Stretch your arm out in front of you with the palm facing down. With your other hand, pull the back of your hand down and toward you until you feel a stretch on the top of the forearm. Hold for 15 to 30 seconds.

RJ7WoP3jwCfoWiiay9BV.d: Sit with your legs straight. Wrap a resistance band around the front of your foot with the other end anchored, then pull the front of your foot up toward you against the band.

e7Ynw9PkqZmlWUqTXZBb.d: Sit in the same position and wrap the band around the outer edge of your foot, anchored to the side. Turn your foot outward against the resistance.

h3V77x6RXHUbeYB156cm.d: Sit in the same position and wrap the band around the inner edge of your foot. Turn your foot inward against the resistance.

3EKDl8vcSVTDBL4tq9NV.d: Sit or lie down with your legs straight. Move your foot up and down at the ankle several times, then make full circles with your foot in both directions.

rV3PkuCpUUCDCRNiGSmN.d: Sit up straight and hold the edge of the chair seat with the hand on the side you want to stretch. Tilt your head to the other side while keeping that shoulder down, until you feel a stretch along the side of your neck and shoulder.

xavlIsxjYmqXgDpnfUn6.d: Sit up straight and tilt your head down and to the side at about 45 degrees, as if looking into your armpit. You can help by placing your hand on top of your head and pushing gently, until you feel a stretch at the back of your neck and shoulder.

nXdwwXJ9VatPoMKxpsDd.d: Sit and place your hand on your forehead, then push your head against your hand without actually moving your head. Repeat the same from the back and from both sides.

NlLOgBcgpFkyAOjHyJJQ.d: Sit up straight and lift your shoulders up toward your ears until you feel them tighten. Hold for 2 seconds, then lower slowly.

kjv0GDcfRMbHKiXzbEgg.d: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your arms raised. Breathing out, slowly lift your head and shoulders until only your shoulder blades come off the floor, tightening your upper belly. Hold for a moment, then lower slowly with control while breathing in, without lifting your lower back off the floor.

RwAspyJYgu4ZfUvjsTQr.d: Stand in a corner of the room with your forearms on the two walls, then gently lean your chest forward until you feel a comfortable stretch across your chest.

7AuQrFT09Tn14pvGXsrA.d: Stand on one leg in the pool and place the other foot on top of a pool noodle, pressing it down. Slowly push the noodle back and down against the water's resistance to strengthen your buttocks and lower back, keeping your body straight.

yO9UXhJDdQRoceMyIrkr.d: Get on your hands and knees, with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. Keep your spine and pelvis in a neutral position without arching your back. Lift one knee just a few centimetres off the floor without any twisting or tilting of your pelvis. Hold for 1 second and lower the knee slowly, then switch sides, keeping your spine as steady as possible.

F95ettfHpgA4UHHqLS2X.n: Bird dog (opposite arm & leg raise on all fours)
F95ettfHpgA4UHHqLS2X.d:
Get on your hands and knees, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips. Stretch out your right arm and left leg at the same time, keeping your back steady without twisting your pelvis, then return and switch sides.
Dose: 10 times each side, hold 5 seconds.

7jk9AtqreqcZR43fW3Jt.d:
Sit back on your heels with your knees slightly apart, lean your body forward and stretch your arms out on the floor in front of you. Let your head rest on the floor or a pillow until you feel a gentle stretch in your lower back.
Dose: 3 times, hold 30 seconds.

fCEFXWCmIdLg1OFUbr8w.d:
Stand next to a wall or chair for safety. Place the heel of one foot right against the toes of the other, as if standing on a straight line, and keep your balance. When it gets easy, try without holding on, and then with your eyes closed.
Dose: 3 times with each leg in front, hold 30 seconds.

DoYPidbGgFkvvDRg3aox.d:
Sit on a chair with your back straight, looking forward. Draw your chin straight back as if making a double chin, without tipping your head down or up, until you feel a gentle stretch at the back of your neck. Hold, then return slowly.
Dose: 2 sets of 10 reps, hold 5 seconds, twice a day.

yfqrInMyAJkJexYRDXlg.d:
Sit with your back straight and your shoulders relaxed. Slowly turn your head to the right as if looking over your shoulder, as far as comfortable without pain, then return to the middle and repeat to the left. Keep your chin level during the movement.
Dose: 10 times each way, twice a day.

jm9ZJIjHriVno8AxdhHp.d:
Sit looking straight ahead. Tilt your head to the side to bring your right ear toward your right shoulder, without lifting the shoulder or turning your face, until you feel a gentle stretch on the opposite side of your neck. Hold, then return and repeat on the other side.
Dose: 5 times each side, hold 15 seconds.

EvxuWWETBI62gUYLb3IM.n: Deep neck flexors – head nod lying on back
EvxuWWETBI62gUYLb3IM.d:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and a small folded towel under your head. Make a very small nod as if saying "yes", bringing your chin toward your neck, without lifting your head off the towel and without tensing the muscles at the front of your neck. Hold while breathing normally, then relax.
Dose: 10 times, hold 10 seconds, once a day.

RbSGEPWqNgUr48DgFRek.n: Shoulder flexion with stick (lying on back)
RbSGEPWqNgUr48DgFRek.d:
Lie on your back with your knees bent, holding a stick with both hands shoulder-width apart, palms down. Slowly raise the stick forward and then over your head, using your good arm to help the affected arm, until you feel a gentle stretch in the shoulder. Lower it slowly.
Dose: 2 sets of 10 reps, twice a day.

qjj3hPQOXNGg79SxzWqb.n: Shoulder external rotation with stick (lying on back)
qjj3hPQOXNGg79SxzWqb.d:
Lie on your back with the elbow of the affected arm against your body and bent to 90 degrees, with a small towel under the elbow. Hold a stick with both hands and use your good arm to push the hand of the affected arm outward, away from your belly, keeping the elbow against your body, until you feel a gentle stretch. Return slowly.
Dose: 2 sets of 10 reps, hold 5 seconds.

vJ3bOSyGhh3CuFicRCZw.d:
Stand facing the wall, a small step away, and place the fingertips of the affected hand on the wall at chest level. Walk your fingers up the wall step by step to the highest comfortable point without hiking your shoulder toward your ear, then walk them back down slowly.
Dose: 10 times, twice a day.

n4ttPpiHnTAcqv7c5Gu0.d:
Sit or stand with your back straight and your arms by your sides. Squeeze your shoulder blades back and down as if holding a pencil between them, without lifting your shoulders or arching your lower back. Hold, then relax slowly.
Dose: 2 sets of 10 reps, hold 5 seconds.

PMVO6qUqzgUgrxgvzFgh.d:
Stand or sit and bring the affected arm across your chest toward the other side. Use your other hand to gently pull the arm, above the elbow, toward your chest until you feel a stretch at the back of the shoulder. Keep the shoulder down and don't twist your trunk.
Dose: 3 times, hold 30 seconds.

L9XLO9ackJPrVsj2wEMA.d:
Sit with your arm by your side and your palm facing forward. Slowly bend your elbow to bring your hand toward your shoulder as far as comfortable, then straighten the elbow fully.
Dose: 2 sets of 15 reps, twice a day.

XWVlUdYFq1LduPlec6PX.n: Forearm rotation – palm up / palm down
XWVlUdYFq1LduPlec6PX.d:
Sit with your elbow against your body, bent to 90 degrees, thumb pointing up. Slowly turn your forearm so your palm faces up, then turn it so your palm faces down, keeping your elbow against your body. For more resistance, hold a light hammer or a water bottle by its end.
Dose: 2 sets of 15 reps.

EX9zHoA1uAQgMSYVYt21.n: Eccentric wrist extensors with weight (tennis elbow)
EX9zHoA1uAQgMSYVYt21.d:
Sit with your forearm resting on a table, wrist over the edge and palm down, holding a light weight or a water bottle. Lift the wrist up with the help of your other hand, then let it lower on its own slowly over 3 to 5 seconds. Mild pain during the exercise is acceptable; stop if the pain becomes sharp.
Dose: 3 sets of 15 reps, once a day.

J5WfoRA53OmdvGG37w7H.d:
Sit with your back straight and raise one arm over your head holding a light weight, supporting the elbow with your other hand. Slowly bend the elbow to lower the weight behind your head, then straighten the elbow back up, keeping your upper arm still beside your head.
Dose: 3 sets of 10–15 reps.

NDn8txiqQ9UsfMM2Xusj.d:
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand over the edge, palm down. Lift your hand up at the wrist as far as comfortable, then lower it down, keeping your forearm still on the table. Repeat with the palm facing up.
Dose: 2 sets of 15 reps, twice a day.

kBqPko3CvW7MXdqbBsAL.d:
Rest your forearm and hand on the table, palm down and fingers straight. Move your hand at the wrist sideways toward the thumb, then toward the little finger, keeping your forearm still and your hand on the table.
Dose: 2 sets of 15 reps.

KVPjKwPt5ZANPxg0jJeO.d:
Start with your hand open and your fingers straight. Move through the following positions in order, returning to the open hand between each one: (1) Hook fist: bend the top and middle finger joints while keeping the knuckles straight. (2) Full fist. (3) Tabletop: bend only at the knuckles, keeping the fingers straight. (4) Straight fist: bend the knuckles and middle joints while keeping the fingertips straight. Hold each position for 3 seconds.
Dose: 10 rounds of the sequence, 3 times a day.

p1L6Mjg5AtkdCDfhUOfR.d:
Sit and hold a soft sponge ball or a rolled towel in your palm. Squeeze it with all your fingers with comfortable force, hold, then slowly relax your hand.
Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps, hold 5 seconds.

2NUddywirEo7a6CMlebV.d:
Place a rubber band around all five fingers at their middle. Open and spread your fingers as far as you can against the band, then bring them back slowly.
Dose: 2 sets of 15 reps.

ZnDtoYT409unVr6J7mqX.d:
Sit with your hand relaxed, palm up. Touch the tip of your thumb to the tip of your index finger to make an "O", then open your hand and touch the tip of your middle finger, and so on up to the little finger. Make sure the tips touch, not the pads of the fingers.
Dose: 2 sets of 10 rounds.

vZaD3PN9uXv19ztTKxIv.d:
Hold a piece of therapy putty or modelling clay between the tip of your thumb and the tip of one finger, and pinch it firmly until it changes shape. Repeat with each finger in turn.
Dose: 10 times with each finger.

djsEQZPv8AzO129RXLJF.d:
Stand or sit and press your palms together in front of your chest in a prayer position, elbows out to the sides. Slowly lower your hands toward your waist while keeping your palms together, until you feel a stretch on the front of your wrists and forearms.
Dose: 3 times, hold 30 seconds.

0ZlF2yeMzXGJqflnIy3m.d:
Sit on a chair with a low back that reaches the middle of your back, and clasp your hands behind your head to support your neck. Slowly lean your upper back backward over the top of the chair, keeping your lower back against the chair, then return.
Dose: 10 times, hold 5 seconds.

60p1KCF2gIBYRyUQ5b2D.d:
Get on your hands and knees, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips. Slowly arch your back up while lowering your head and looking toward your belly, then gently let your belly sink toward the floor while raising your head and looking forward. Move slowly and steadily with your breathing, without pain.
Dose: 2 sets of 10 reps.

MpGucfZpfsiRq3UVeMoi.d:
Anchor the middle of a resistance band to a door handle or something stable in front of you at chest level, and hold both ends with your arms straight. Pull the band back, bending your elbows at your sides and squeezing your shoulder blades together, without lifting your shoulders, then return slowly.
Dose: 3 sets of 15 reps.

dvF623LfF85HM93qvTVT.d:
Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor and your arms crossed over your chest. Slowly turn your upper trunk to the right as far as comfortable, keeping your hips and knees still, then return to the middle and repeat to the left.
Dose: 10 times each way.

lqVHk3R2JYXuId9xhaS5.n: Posterior pelvic tilt (flatten back lying down)
lqVHk3R2JYXuId9xhaS5.d:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet on the floor. Tighten your belly muscles and tilt your pelvis back so your lower back presses flat into the floor and the gap underneath disappears, without lifting your hips or holding your breath. Hold, then relax.
Dose: 2 sets of 10 reps, hold 5 seconds.

jn3FStgStfdwtLAmzfzM.n: Lower back rotation – knees side to side
jn3FStgStfdwtLAmzfzM.d:
Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet on the floor and arms stretched out to the sides. Slowly lower both knees together to the right as far as comfortable, keeping your shoulders on the floor, then return to the middle and repeat to the left.
Dose: 10 times each side.

lpH8eiPXyQlct0fkIkCc.n: Dead bug (core – opposite arm & leg lowering)
lpH8eiPXyQlct0fkIkCc.d:
Lie on your back with your arms raised toward the ceiling and your legs lifted so your hips and knees are bent to 90 degrees. Tighten your belly and press your lower back into the floor, then slowly lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor without letting your lower back lift. Return and switch sides.
Dose: 2 sets of 10 reps each side.

GMZ4S4SHn29zDAfoqvtY.d:
Lie on your back with your knees bent. Tighten your lower belly by drawing your belly button in, then slide the heel of one leg along the floor until the leg is straight, keeping your pelvis still and your back from arching. Bring it back and repeat with the other leg.
Dose: 10 times each leg.

uEMbmdF01L5yo8f0xWLH.n: Hip extension lying on stomach (leg raise backward)
uEMbmdF01L5yo8f0xWLH.d:
Lie on your stomach, with a pillow under your belly if needed. Squeeze your buttock, then lift one straight leg a few centimetres off the floor without arching your lower back or twisting your pelvis. Hold, then lower it slowly.
Dose: 2 sets of 10–15 reps each leg, hold 3 seconds.

gFbQhXzCSma9lZqzA1CS.d:
Stand holding the back of a chair or a table. Lift one leg out to the side, keeping it straight with the foot pointing forward and without leaning your trunk to the other side, then lower it slowly.
Dose: 2 sets of 15 reps each leg.

sQzPwZBWhhreMw0bkVkB.d:
Sit on the edge of a stable chair with your feet on the floor, hip-width apart and slightly behind your knees. Lean your trunk forward and stand up using your leg muscles, without pushing with your hands if possible, then sit back down slowly and with control.
Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps.

1UpwD2G1XoNiZTMtAILq.n: Short arc quads (straighten knee over towel roll)
1UpwD2G1XoNiZTMtAILq.d:
Lie on your back or sit with your leg straight and place a rolled towel or a bottle under your knee. Tighten the muscle at the front of your thigh and straighten your knee to lift your heel off the floor, keeping the knee resting on the towel. Hold, then lower slowly.
Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps, hold 5 seconds.

PphxUY9jknGEH8PVg7Rc.d:
Sit on a chair with your back supported and your feet on the floor. Slowly straighten your knee until the leg is fully straight, tightening the muscle at the front of your thigh. Hold, then lower slowly. As you improve, you can add a light weight around your ankle.
Dose: 3 sets of 10–15 reps, hold 3 seconds.

sK2VX4jMfOdTD4AmSKrt.n: Heel slide – knee bending lying down
sK2VX4jMfOdTD4AmSKrt.d:
Lie on your back with your legs straight. Slide the heel of the affected leg along the floor toward your buttock to bend the knee as far as comfortable, hold for a moment, then slide it back until the knee is straight. A plastic bag under the heel makes sliding easier.
Dose: 2 sets of 15 reps.

EjGfuvwknDPRTdQNb01s.d:
Tie a resistance band around something stable in front of you and place the other end behind the affected knee while standing. Bend the knee slightly, then straighten it fully against the band while tightening the front of your thigh. Hold, then return slowly.
Dose: 3 sets of 15 reps, hold 3 seconds.

k7X9WWHJkknXQLc8Eq1h.d:
Sit and lift your foot off the floor, or rest your leg on another chair. Draw the letters of the alphabet in the air with your big toe, moving only your ankle and keeping your knee still.
Dose: the whole alphabet once, 2–3 times a day.

7iFtItXVmULZE8xJKJEO.d:
Sit with your leg straight in front of you and loop a towel around the front of your foot, holding both ends. Slowly pull the towel toward you, keeping your knee straight, until you feel a stretch in the calf at the back of your lower leg.
Dose: 3 times, hold 30 seconds.

63PyxflMTbv8QCB7csFk.d:
Sit on a chair with a towel spread flat on the floor under your foot. Gather the towel toward you using only your toes, keeping your heel on the floor, until you have gathered the whole towel.
Dose: 3 times the length of the towel.

SpBwo5Bq1ZKu8frkhYZR.d:
Stand next to a wall or table for safety. Lift one foot off the floor and keep your balance on the other leg, keeping your pelvis level. As you improve, try it with your eyes closed or standing on a cushion.
Dose: 3 times each leg, hold 30 seconds.

TcuZxijuGL3SBv31bQdr.d:
Sit and place the affected foot on the knee of the other leg. Hold your toes and pull them up toward your shin until you feel a stretch in the sole of your foot; you can feel the tight band with your other hand. Best done in the morning before your first step.
Dose: 3 times, hold 30 seconds.

A5S89pIfVzZSms9eojTj.d:
Walk along a straight line so the heel of your front foot touches the toes of your back foot with every step, looking ahead, with a wall beside you for safety.
Dose: 3 rounds of 10 steps.

5RURHCs0wLqUZQxsqA1B.d:
Stand next to a chair or table for safety and lift your knees one after the other as high as comfortable, as if walking on the spot, keeping your trunk upright.
Dose: 3 rounds of 30 seconds.

Pyrok8jd8KT9aXNRwHxS.d:
Stand holding the back of a chair. Lift the front of your feet and stand on your heels, then come down and rise up onto your toes, moving slowly and with control.
Dose: 2 sets of 10 reps.

xUGRacV0LZ6SmGILJu4a.d:
Stand next to a table or wall with your knees slightly bent. Take side steps along the table and back, keeping your feet pointing forward and not bringing them fully together. To make it harder, add a resistance band around your knees.
Dose: 3 rounds of 10 steps each way.

PRuRDNPZRm4eVqQ582Mn.n: Jaw rest position – tongue on palate
PRuRDNPZRm4eVqQ582Mn.d:
Sit with your back straight. Place the tip of your tongue on the roof of your mouth just behind your upper front teeth, keep your teeth slightly apart and your lips gently closed, and breathe through your nose. This is the correct resting position for the jaw; use it during the day instead of clenching your teeth.
Dose: 6 times, hold 10 seconds, 6 times a day.

Ew1jNr4BglSdsCoqkGGk.d:
Stand in front of a mirror and place the tip of your tongue on the roof of your mouth behind your front teeth. Slowly open your mouth while keeping your tongue in place, so your jaw moves down in a straight line without shifting right or left, then close slowly.
Dose: 6 times, 6 times a day.

AM9JIRJBClYCCgayzax9.d:
Sit and place something thin, such as a tongue depressor, between your front teeth with your mouth slightly open. Slowly move your lower jaw to the right, then to the left, within a comfortable, pain-free range.
Dose: 10 times each way.

Ob69bm7omV9BHbOaXh8T.n: Jaw isometric – open & close against thumb
Ob69bm7omV9BHbOaXh8T.d:
Sit and place your thumb under your chin. Try to open your mouth slowly against light resistance from your thumb without the jaw actually moving, hold, then relax. Repeat with two fingers on the front of your chin while trying to close.
Dose: 5 times each way, hold 5 seconds.

D2YfXDREJBBclzK7MvOe.d:
Lie on your back with your knees bent, or sit supported, with one hand on your chest and the other on your belly. Breathe in slowly through your nose so the hand on your belly rises while the hand on your chest stays almost still, then breathe out slowly through your mouth as your belly falls.
Dose: 10 breaths, 3–4 times a day.

yaaJsGvmRkgOrpfotTLG.d:
Sit comfortably with your shoulders relaxed. Breathe in through your nose for a count of two, then purse your lips as if about to whistle and breathe out slowly through them for a count of four or more, so the breath out is about twice as long as the breath in.
Dose: 10 breaths, when short of breath and during effort.

qvkwpZgoRa4jGn52JQCe.d:
Sit and place your hands on both sides of your lower ribs. Breathe in slowly through your nose, sending the air toward your hands so your ribcage expands sideways and pushes them out, then breathe out slowly while pressing gently with your hands.
Dose: 10 breaths, 3 times a day.

LOooLKsUTueueB77Qies.n: Huffing – forced exhale to clear phlegm
LOooLKsUTueueB77Qies.d:
Sit up straight. Take a medium breath in, then breathe out forcefully through an open mouth as if fogging up a mirror ("haaah"), without closing your throat as in a cough. Repeat once or twice, then rest with calm breathing, and cough when you feel phlegm.
Dose: 2–3 rounds, when you need to clear phlegm.

71GxMkqDrPwYk7ZiW0IO.d:
Lie on your back with your knees bent, or sit. Tighten your pelvic floor muscles as if trying to stop the flow of urine and hold in gas at the same time, drawing them in and up, while breathing normally and without tensing your belly, buttocks or thighs. Hold the squeeze, then relax completely and rest between repetitions. Do not do this exercise while actually urinating.
Dose: 10 times, hold 5–10 seconds, 3 times a day.

GEZaDDcYphPdA1AJk7ki.d:
In the same position, tighten your pelvic floor muscles quickly and strongly, then relax them fully straight away, breathing normally and without tensing your belly or buttocks.
Dose: 10 quick squeezes, 3 times a day.

Sik8jW8Celkjx6agH4Pu.n: The Knack – pelvic floor squeeze before cough / sneeze
Sik8jW8Celkjx6agH4Pu.d:
Learn to tighten your pelvic floor muscles just before you cough, sneeze, laugh or lift something heavy, keep them tight during the effort, then relax afterwards, to reduce urine leakage.
Dose: use it during the day with every cough, sneeze or lift.

qvFweOpIf7iXZusMrzjE.n: Shoulder horizontal abduction & adduction in pool
qvFweOpIf7iXZusMrzjE.d:
Starting position:
Stand in chest-deep water with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Hold an aqua dumbbell in each hand, arms straight in front of you on the surface of the water.

How to do it:
1. Open your arms out to the sides along the surface, keeping your elbows almost straight.
2. At the end of the movement, gently squeeze your shoulder blades together.
3. Slowly bring your arms back to the front.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps.

1t6N0kCKv8zDilO6jtzv.d:
Starting position:
Stand in chest-deep water with your feet apart. Hold an aqua dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides under the water, palms facing in.

How to do it:
1. Raise your arms out to the sides up to the surface, helped by the float of the dumbbells.
2. Hold for 1 second.
3. Slowly push the dumbbells down until they are back by your sides.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps.

a8DoFWHcVS7tJ38WWJeR.d:
Starting position:
Stand in chest-deep water. Keep your elbows against your body, bent to about 90 degrees, holding an aqua dumbbell in each hand on the surface of the water.

How to do it:
1. Push the dumbbells down by straightening your elbows until your arms are straight by your sides.
2. Let the dumbbells rise slowly as you bend your elbows back to the starting position.
3. Keep your upper arms still throughout the movement.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps.

92YAU8tlWx3Dxo07OS6c.d:
Starting position:
Stand in chest-deep water with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Hold an aqua dumbbell in each hand, arms straight by your sides.

How to do it:
1. Move both arms together forward and up, keeping your elbows straight.
2. Then push both arms back together.
3. Repeat the movement smoothly while keeping your body steady.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps.

9lMi5dS9UOggOvJXcA56.d:
Starting position:
Stand in chest-deep water with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Hold an aqua dumbbell in each hand, arms straight in front of you on the surface of the water.

How to do it:
1. Bend forward from your hips, pushing the dumbbells forward along the surface.
2. Bend only as far as is comfortable.
3. Slowly return to standing using your back and buttock muscles.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps.

vcipTIJw43QlkRtb7981.n: Standing hip & knee flexion in pool
vcipTIJw43QlkRtb7981.d:
Starting position:
Stand upright in waist- to chest-deep water with your feet hip-width apart. Hold the pool edge with one hand if you need support.

How to do it:
1. Lift one knee in front of you to about hip height.
2. Straighten the leg, then slowly lower it to the floor.
3. Repeat with the other leg, keeping your back straight.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps each leg.

7OFgtDChXFEIswYzPrTN.d:
Starting position:
Stand upright in waist- to chest-deep water, facing or beside the pool wall, holding the edge for balance.

How to do it:
1. Move one leg backward, keeping the knee straight.
2. Squeeze your buttock at the end of the movement.
3. Slowly bring the leg back to the start, then switch legs.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps each leg.

PXYLxD7kCf17TYBCTkNp.d:
Starting position:
Stand upright in waist- to chest-deep water with your feet together. Hold the pool edge, or place your hands on your chest if your balance is good.

How to do it:
1. Move one leg out to the side, keeping the knee straight and your toes pointing forward.
2. Pull the leg back in toward the other leg against the water's resistance.
3. Repeat the movement, then switch legs.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps each leg.

w1mQOL4PwdX3MC6LAhYI.n: Hip internal & external rotation in pool
w1mQOL4PwdX3MC6LAhYI.d:
Starting position:
Stand with your back against the pool wall and your arms on the edge for support. Lift one leg slightly in front of you so the water supports it.

How to do it:
1. Turn the whole leg inward from the hip, keeping the knee straight (toes pointing in).
2. Then turn it outward (toes pointing out).
3. Repeat the movement smoothly, then switch legs.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps each leg.

bVe1ucvjJGcN5PKgTn0r.n: Floating trunk side bending at pool wall
bVe1ucvjJGcN5PKgTn0r.d:
Starting position:
Stand with your back against the pool wall, arms spread along the edge, holding on. Let your legs float in front of you, with a pool noodle under your ankles for support.

How to do it:
1. Move both legs together to one side, bending your trunk at the waist.
2. Slowly bring them back to the middle.
3. Repeat the movement to the other side.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps each side.

zY6D2VabRUPm9I46QpaI.n: Standing trunk side bending in pool
zY6D2VabRUPm9I46QpaI.d:
Starting position:
Stand in chest-deep water with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart. Hold an aqua dumbbell in each hand, arms straight out to the sides on the surface of the water.

How to do it:
1. Bend your trunk to one side so one dumbbell goes down into the water and the other rises.
2. Slowly return to upright.
3. Repeat to the other side, keeping your pelvis steady.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps each side.

pZnE1lawz7GSY87fd616.d:
Starting position:
Stand in chest-deep water with your knees slightly bent. Hold an aqua dumbbell in each hand, arms straight by your sides.

How to do it:
1. Move one arm forward and the other back at the same time, keeping your elbows straight.
2. Alternate between your arms at a calm, steady rhythm.
3. Keep your trunk steady and don't twist your body.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps each arm.

dPTIqe6b6tTChkrdQiy8.d:
Starting position:
Start in half-kneeling (one knee on the floor and the other foot forward), or stand with one foot in front of the other. Hold an aqua dumbbell in each hand, arms straight out to the sides on the surface of the water.

How to do it:
1. Turn your upper body to one side so one dumbbell moves forward and the other back.
2. Slowly return to the middle.
3. Repeat to the other side, keeping your pelvis facing forward.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps each side.

VA13dOwllUBVnWynixYv.n: Shoulder extension with kickboard in pool
VA13dOwllUBVnWynixYv.d:
Starting position:
Stand in chest-deep water and bend your knees into a half squat so your shoulders are close to the surface. Hold a kickboard flat on the surface with both hands in front of your chest.

How to do it:
1. Push the board down into the water toward your thighs, keeping your elbows almost straight.
2. Hold for a moment without arching your back.
3. Let the board rise slowly back to the surface.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps.

ZEflnQb7cLeeuCZHUe3g.n: Trunk rotation with kickboard in squat
ZEflnQb7cLeeuCZHUe3g.d:
Starting position:
Stand in chest-deep water with your feet wider than hip-width apart and your knees bent in a half squat. Hold a kickboard upright in the water in front of you with both hands.

How to do it:
1. Turn your upper body to one side, pushing the board through the water.
2. Slowly return to the middle.
3. Repeat to the other side, keeping your pelvis and knees steady.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps each side.

d1h2qx3MXAHPBhAQlecT.n: Knee extension with kickboard in pool
d1h2qx3MXAHPBhAQlecT.d:
Starting position:
Stand with your back against the pool wall, holding the edge with both hands. Bend one knee and place your foot on a kickboard on the surface of the water.

How to do it:
1. Push the board down by straightening your knee.
2. Hold for a moment at the bottom.
3. Let the board rise slowly as you bend your knee, then switch legs.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps each leg.

R5EbqfsI8MMKRiVdBBrs.d:
Starting position:
Stand in waist- to chest-deep water with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms stretched forward on the surface for balance.

How to do it:
1. Slowly bend your knees and hips as if sitting on a chair behind you.
2. Go down only as far as is comfortable, keeping your knees in line with your toes.
3. Push through your heels to stand back up.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps.

739wlxil12yl8NZRJLzs.n: Floating knee to chest at pool wall
739wlxil12yl8NZRJLzs.d:
Starting position:
Stand with your back against the pool wall, arms spread along the edge, holding on. Let your legs float in front of you.

How to do it:
1. Bend both knees together and slowly pull them toward your chest.
2. Straighten your legs again along the surface of the water.
3. Keep your back against the wall throughout the movement.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps.

fHY0K02XrQU7DuP3aJjU.d:
Starting position:
Stand with your back against the pool wall, arms spread along the edge, holding on. Lift your legs slightly in front of you.

How to do it:
1. Move your legs in circles as if riding a bicycle.
2. Keep the movement smooth and continuous.
3. Breathe normally, keeping your back against the wall.

Dose: 3 sets of 30–60 seconds each.

17VdmDA67Tr9GkmrnSyF.n: Floating hip abduction at pool wall
17VdmDA67Tr9GkmrnSyF.d:
Starting position:
Stand with your back against the pool wall, arms spread along the edge, holding on. Let your legs float in front of you.

How to do it:
1. Open both legs out to the sides as far as is comfortable, keeping your knees straight.
2. Slowly bring them back together.
3. Keep your toes pointing up and your back against the wall.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps.

X9U20IjX3Pcg7WYeZN2l.d:
Starting position:
Stand with your back against the pool wall, arms spread along the edge, holding on. Let your legs float in front of you with a pool noodle under your feet.

How to do it:
1. Lift one leg and push the other down, keeping both knees straight.
2. Alternate between your legs at a slow, steady rhythm.
3. Keep your back against the wall and your trunk steady.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps each leg.

JURRfRaeehfnq76qvuuH.n: Prone hip extension at pool wall
JURRfRaeehfnq76qvuuH.d:
Starting position:
Stand facing the pool wall, holding the edge with your arms straight. Lean your body forward so it is almost level in the water.

How to do it:
1. Lift one leg back toward the surface of the water, keeping the knee straight.
2. Squeeze your buttock at the top.
3. Lower the leg slowly, then switch legs.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps each leg.

EtdUtviWVnOisSw04itz.d:
Starting position:
Stand beside the pool wall in waist- to chest-deep water, holding the edge with one hand.

How to do it:
1. Place the ankle of one leg over the knee of the other leg.
2. Bend the knee of the standing leg and slowly sit back until you feel a stretch in the buttock of the crossed leg.
3. Hold, then return and switch legs.

Dose: 3 times each leg, hold 20–30 seconds.

2pOOPWr1kUM7pg5PGT8p.d:
Starting position:
Stand with your back against the pool wall, arms spread along the edge, holding on. Let your legs float in front of you with a pool noodle at your feet.

How to do it:
1. Turn both legs together with your pelvis to one side.
2. Slowly return to the middle.
3. Repeat to the other side, keeping your shoulders against the wall.

Dose: 3 sets of 10 reps each side.
